The older process was killed by PID; exactly one process completed and wrote the final artifacts. Log and artifacts are internally consistent with the surviving single run (one RESULT line, n=32, schema_failures=3). Deviation logged in TASK-LOCK execution_notes; final artifacts treated as authoritative single-run output.
